Conclusion 
•
Economies of scale have not yet been fully exploited in 
laterite nickel metallurgical plants to minimize CAPEX and 
OPEX per unit of Ni production 
 
•
Recently constructed / started-up and pyromet and 
hydroment plants have excellent upgrade potential 
– Adding technology to increase productivity of existing unit operations 
– Adding additional production line(s) to take advantage of already spent  
site infrastructure costs. 
 
•
Incremental expansion of production capacity can be highly 
cost effective 
– Debottlenecking to reach design production rate 
– Exploitation of latent overcapacity in some production steps by 
upgrading rate limiting unit operations
